rules: Every discovered project has exactly one evidence record.
Evidence collection requires a fresh project index and stays inside that index scope.
Workers are read-only and never write the system document.
Workers emit individually reviewable structured relation candidates in addition to narrative outbound dependencies.
A clean worker returns scopeStatus CLEAN and an empty scopeViolations array; no-violation explanations never belong in that array.
Actual scope violations and credential or secret values are recorded or removed and block the downstream gate; architecture identifiers remain intact.
